A new console mode.

## New

- **Console mode** (F11, or the controller icon in the title bar) is a new fullscreen home screen: your box art fills the background, each console has its own tab, and under a game you'll find its details and more games from the same console. Press A or Enter to play, B or Backspace to go back, and the menu button or P for the control center (what's running, the app's status, mute, exit). Controller, keyboard and mouse all work.
- Covers that finish downloading after console mode opens show up right away.

## Needs

- The Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. It comes with Windows 10 and 11; if it's missing, console mode says where to get it.

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| **SteamStopper.msi** | Most people. Installs, adds shortcuts, updates itself. |
| **SteamStopper-portable.zip** | No install: unzip and run `SteamStopper.exe`. Includes .NET. |
| SteamStopper.zip | Used by installed copies to update. You don't need it. |
| \*.sha256 | Checksums for the files above. |

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Asks for Administrator: firewall, DNS and routes need it.
